name: Fujiwara no Yukitaka
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Byakko of Heaven for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Father (deceased), Mother, older half-brother, younger sister
Occupation: Middle Counselor / Kebiishi-Bettō
Innate Element: Metal
Weapon(s): Uchigatana (archaic samurai sword)
Hobbies: Reading and composing Chinese poetry
Favorite Scent: Jijuu
Favorite Color: Usumoegi (light yellow-green)
Favorite Flower(s): Japanese clovers (autumn) / Satsuma (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
